text_block_list.name: Habitual Sneaking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wah-pfft! Bird feathers from above?! 
Wait, what is this?! They won't come off 
at all!

text_block_list.name: Binge-Eating Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what's this?! Everywhere I step, it 
squeaks, it squeaks! 
This makes no seeeense!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought... since I went around 
bragging about how amazing the traps were. 
I knew no true bad girl could resist a 
challenge!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Kukuku, my greeting to you is Bird Feather 
Hell!! 
They stick to you and won't come off, 
super annoying, right?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on the Record Board
text_block_list.text:
That string looks totally suspicious. 
Heh, it's way too obvious—Cold! A water 
gun trap?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Too naive! A decoy trap is standard 
practice! 
Fuhahahaha! Serves you right, intruders!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I can read you bad girls like an open 
book! Once provoked, a bad girl can't stay 
quiet! 
You guys were such a piece of cake~♪

text_block_list.name: Habitual Sneaking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Guh... you sounded so confident, after 
all! 
Of course we'd want to test it out and 
break through!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you acting so naughty, all the 
intruders gathered in one place! 
Mission accomplished!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Now then, this is where the real talk 
begins! 
We want everyone to stop sneaking into the 
archive room!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on the Record Board
text_block_list.text:
Wait, so in the end this was just a 
Disciplinary Committee trap?! 
You gathered us here just to turn us in 
to—!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in the Wall Graffiti
text_block_list.text:
Wait! I don't think that's true. 
Because... Urara-san wrote it on the 
sticky note.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
! Could you be... "Pace Reader"-san?! 
Wah, you actually came! I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in the Wall Graffiti
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. After getting such a heartfelt 
message, well... 
I really wanted to try talking with you.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"You ran with a Front Runner, didn't you? 
I ran with a Front Runner too, and I was 
so surprised by how fast they were!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Once the gates open, they go zooooom! and 
dash ahead, right? 
When it's a fast pace, they just get 
further and further away!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"But having someone running ahead of you 
is fun, isn't it? Like, 'I'm gonna catch 
up~!' 
Every bit closer you get makes your heart 
beat sooooo excitedly!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder how exciting it would be if we 
caught up and took 1st place? 
I can't wait to find out! —From Haru 
Urara"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in the Wall Graffiti
text_block_list.text:
Reading your message... it felt like you 
understood why we come here. 
Am I wrong?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! Windy-chan and the others run 
in races too, after all. 
For Tracen students, this is a necessary 
place.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in the Wall Graffiti
text_block_list.text:
See? So why don't we hear them out? We 
came because we wanted to hear what kind 
of proposal "The Undaunted by Defeat, Haru 
Urara" had to offer.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
We don't want to capture anyone! 
We were just asked to investigate the 
storage room!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
An investigation means the academy wanted 
to know your reasons too. 
So, I think we can negotiate!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
We want you to stop sneaking in—that's our 
wish. 
What about yours? Tell us what you want!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
We promise we'll convey it properly to the 
academy!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on the Record Board
text_block_list.text:
...So you seriously came to negotiate. 
That's totally unexpected, or rather... 
hearing you say that while fully 
understanding our motives...

text_block_list.name: Habitual Sneaking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, honestly, it makes me happy. You 
didn't tell us we're pathetic for lashing 
out, or barbaric for running wild in 
anger.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't say that! 
Windy-chan chomps and bites when she 
loses, too!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on the Record Board
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, chomping?! You're way more of a 
rascal than us! 
...All right, let's think up a negotiation 
proposal for the academy together.

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
W-We did itttttt! 
Y-Yayyyyyyy!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Splendid... That was a magnificent 
operation!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the squad members I placed 
my trust in, sir!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Commander Fenomeno?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Please leave the rest to me...! I promise 
that I will not betray the trust of 
everyone who responded to us today, sir!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
W-W-Why are you here?! 
If you come to a place like this—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Rest assured, I obtained proper permission 
before coming. 
I simply had to witness your gallant 
efforts with my own eyes, sir!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: Commaaaandeeeer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah! Commander! 
Were you watching? Urara did her best!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because you're Urara-san, always 
doing your best with a smile, your words 
resonated with them. That is something 
only you could have accomplished, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Because of Big-san's unyielding strength, 
everyone was able to keep moving forward! 
And Biko-san's straightforward, empathetic 
words conveyed our sincerity!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Windy-san's mischievous plan paved the 
path to a solution! By playing to 
everyone's strengths, you all joined 
forces and succeeded...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Truly... truly, all of you are... hngh, 
I'm s-soorryyyy! 
I-I'm at a l-loss for w-woooords, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, thank goodness... *sniff*! 
I was able to properly fulfill my role...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone's such a crybaby. 
Windy-chan is a bad girl, so... I'm not 
gonna cry...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, we are so happy and our hearts are 
so full— 
Let us share this joy together, everyone!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—Commander, how did the investigation 
report go?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
As long as the students stop sneaking in, 
there will be no penalties this time. The 
academy will not identify the students 
either.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, the academy will consider 
providing a place where students can take 
their time to reflect on themselves in the 
future.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to all of you, I was able to 
accomplish my mission as well!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—And with that, the Reference Archives 
Survey Team has completed its mission! 
Thank you all very much for your 
cooperation!
